svg.title: AI Pioneer Program — the first generation of AI builders
svg.desc: AI Pioneer Program with Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Washington. Ages 11–18 build agents, apps and games with frontier models, deploy them, and leave with a public portfolio and a portable credential. Program principle: if it's not deployed, it's not finished. Pipeline: prompt, agent, app, deploy, portfolio, credential.
svg.text: AI PIONEER PROGRAM · WITH BOYS & GIRLS CLUBS OF GREATER WASHINGTON
